description: PPRL Pays des Olonnes - Enjeux surfaciques des risques inondation et du Pays des Olonnes - Vendée is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vendee.gouv.fr. The surface issues are people, property, activities, cultural or environmental heritage elements, threatened by hazard. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "PPRL Pays des Olonnes — Flood risk and marine submersion issues of the Pays des Olonnes — Vendée" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, pays olonne enjeux. The listing shows 2017-04-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
